newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 4.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:

* The new tax law passed by Congress last week will eliminate Americans' right to defer taxes when they sell an old home and buy a new one -- a change that will be costly to owners of high-priced homes.
* Clinton Administration officials said they doubt they will reach broad agreement this year to admit China to the World Trade Organization.
* So far, attandance at games of the new Women's National Basketball Association have exceeded by twofold even the most optimistic predictions.

* After Wednesday's suicide bombing in a crowded Jerusalem market, the Israeli government is alleging that Palestinian leader Yasir Arafat bears primary responsibility for refusing to cooperate fully on security matters.
* Barney's Inc said it reached an agreement that would give control of the retailer to Hong Kong-based Dickson Concepts.
* Authorities are questioning stories by a Palestinian man accused of plotting suicide bombings in New York regarding torture at the hands of the Israeli military.
* A revolutionary shift in attitudes toward the elderly appears to be under way in Japan, as well as in Korea and China.
* For the first time in a decade, U.S. Supreme Court justices are about to take up the controversial question of affirmative action.
